_comment: Digital Asset Links. This is what tells Android that the app signed with
the fingerprint below is allowed to show rexgiddotyhubs.shop without a
browser address bar across the top.
PLACEHOLDER — the app is not built yet. Replace sha256_cert_fingerprints
with the value from the package PWABuilder produces (it ships its own
assetlinks.json in the zip; copy the fingerprint out of it), and set
package_name to the one you chose there.
Until that is done this file changes nothing, and the site is unaffected.
